paper_title: An improved limit on the axion-photon coupling from the CAST experiment
notes: CAST phase I (vacuum) solar-axion helioscope. Headline result Eq.(21): g_agamma < 8.8e-11 GeV^-1 at 95% CL for m_a <~ 0.02 eV, valid where the axion-photon oscillation length exceeds the magnet length. Curve traced from the blue 'CAST phase I' vector path in figure8.eps (e-print, ROOT EPS) '0 0 1 c 317 1000 m 830 X ... d s'. X-axis calibration: x=317px -> 1e-5 eV, 306.17 px/decade (major ticks 10^-5..10^1). Y-axis: y=307px -> 1e-12 GeV^-1, 355.8 px/decade (10^-12..10^-7). Flat portion recovers g=8.87e-11, matching the quoted 8.8e-11. Above ~0.02 eV coherence is lost and the limit degrades, rising to ~4.1e-8 GeV^-1 at 7.46 eV (the right edge of the plotted curve). First point at 1e-5 eV is the left frame edge (flat line extends to arbitrarily low mass). Not a dark-matter search, so dm_density is null.
